notes: Frame intervals are single local production samples, not device-wide smoothness guarantees.
Single-stream timing spans fetch start through completion plus a 500ms settling period.
Concurrent prose measurement starts after both sends and after the left pane scrolls up; it excludes earlier admission and output.
Concurrent code/math holds both synthetic transports until both sends are admitted and the left pane is scrolled up, then measures cold output through completion.
First ungated rich diagnostic could not establish overlap; it was rejected by the probe and is not a qualifying performance sample.
